_about: 52in1's catalogue and session tags for Shardfall (AI Hub Catalogue v1 and Session Protocol v1, docs/AI_HUB.md). scripts/pack_single_html.py --hub writes them into the page's <head>; hub:model and hub:effort come from its --model and --effort, given when the package is made. moments must match pav_core::arpg::moments::MOMENTS (crates/pav_core/tests/moments.rs checks).
name: Shardfall
tagline: A hack-and-slash descent into a shattered world
description: A fast hack-and-slash action RPG: take a hero down through a shattered underworld, cut through monsters, gather loot and grow a passive tree. Up to four players descend together.
controls: WASD to move; mouse to aim; click or right click to attack; Q / E / R / F skills; Space to dodge; 1 potion; G to use; Esc for menu; gamepads to play and join

goals.default: Clear the depths together before time runs out
goals.parallel: Descend as deep as you can before time runs out
goals.ghost: Descend as deep as you can before time runs out
goals.co-op: Clear the depths together before time runs out
goals.versus: Slay more monsters than the others before time runs out
goals.moments: Clear each moment's goal before its time runs out

session_howto: WASD or stick to move · mouse aim · click, Q, E, R, F skills · Space dodge
moments: pack defeat 25 Defeat every monster in the pack
champion defeat 30 Slay the champion and its guards
swarm survive 20 Stay alive while the swarm closes in
gold collect 20 Grab every pile of gold before time runs out
